rubrics.justification: The image does not convincingly show a fully expanded stage 4 blastocyst with a clear blastocoel or thinning zona. ICM and TE are poorly defined, so assigning 4BB/4BC and describing visible vacuoles/perivitelline debris overstates features not clearly discernible.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, smoking, prior ectopic, sperm parameters, and endometrium, and relates them to prognosis, though some links are somewhat generalized.
The structure is logical, but the prognosis is built on a likely overcalled embryo grade and includes several speculative percentage adjustments, reducing the strength of the reasoning.

Many recommendations are standard (proceed with transfer, smoking cessation, early ectopic surveillance), but suggestions such as routine estradiol addition, aspirin, ERA after a second failure, and PGT-A because of PCOS are not strongly guideline-based.

The response gives practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, and future planning, especially regarding smoking cessation and early pregnancy follow-up, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard.
